validator_notes: Canonical double-entry bookkeeping system in plain text; actively maintained (v3.2.3 released May 2026, 6415 commits); GPL-2.0 confirmed on GitHub and PyPI; strong provenance for parsing P&L and balance sheet records into structured data.

Plain-text double-entry accounting CLI and library; actively maintained (v1.52.1 April 2026); GPL-3.0+ confirmed; useful for SDE normalization via journal parsing and report generation from SMB financial records.

Canonical OSS small-business double-entry accounting application (v5.15 March 2026, 74 releases); GPL-2.0-or-later confirmed; exposes Python bindings and XML/SQLite data formats suitable for read-only ingestion of SMB books.

Canonical open-source ERP with a full accounting module (general ledger, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow); actively maintained (v16.18.3 May 2026, 57932 commits); GPL-3.0+ confirmed; API-accessible for read-only ingestion of SMB chart-of-accounts and financial statements.

Python library for consuming OFXv1/v2 bank and brokerage feeds; 1004 commits, GPL-3.0 confirmed on PyPI; last PyPI release v0.9.5 (Jan 2022) is a moderate staleness flag but CI still active on GitHub; useful for ingesting SMB bank statement exports as part of add-back identification workflows.
